<?php
/**
 * Multi-tenant File Processing Service
 * Handles secure file uploads and processing with tenant isolation
 */

class TenantFileProcessor {
    private $baseDir;
    private $lockDir;
    private $tenantId;
    private $maxFileSize = 10485760; // 10MB

    public function __construct(string $tenantId) {
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/', $tenantId)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid tenant ID format');
        }
        $this->tenantId = $tenantId;
        $this->baseDir = '/var/data/tenants/' . $tenantId . '/files';
        $this->lockDir = '/var/data/locks';
        
        if (!is_dir($this->baseDir)) {
            mkdir($this->baseDir, 0750, true);
        }
        if (!is_dir($this->lockDir)) {
            mkdir($this->lockDir, 0750, true);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Acquire an advisory lock for a specific file operation
     */
    private function acquireLock(string $resourceId): ?resource {
        $lockFile = $this->lockDir . '/' . hash('sha256', $resourceId) . '.lock';
        $fp = fopen($lockFile, 'c');
        if ($fp === false) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!flock($fp, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) {
            fclose($fp);
            return null;
        }
        return $fp;
    }

    private function releaseLock($fp): void {
        if (is_resource($fp)) {
            flock($fp, LOCK_UN);
            fclose($fp);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Validate that a resolved path belongs to the current tenant
     */
    private function validateTenantPath(string $path): bool {
        $resolved = realpath(dirname($path));
        if ($resolved === false) {
            return false;
        }
        $tenantBase = realpath($this->baseDir);
        return strpos($resolved, $tenantBase) === 0;
    }

    /**
     * Process an uploaded file: validate, transform, and store
     * Uses two-phase commit: write to staging, then atomically move
     */
    public function processUpload(string $tmpFile, string $targetName): array {
        // Sanitize target filename
        $targetName = basename($targetName);
        $targetName = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/', '', $targetName);
        if (empty($targetName) || $targetName[0] === '.') {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid filename'];
        }

        $targetPath = $this->baseDir . '/' . $targetName;
        
        // Check file size
        $size = filesize($tmpFile);
        if ($size === false || $size > $this->maxFileSize) {
            return ['error' => 'File too large'];
        }

        // Phase 1: Write to staging area with tenant-scoped lock
        $lockResource = $this->acquireLock($this->tenantId . ':' . $targetName);
        if ($lockResource === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Resource busy, try again'];
        }

        try {
            $stagingPath = $this->baseDir . '/.staging_' . $targetName;
            
            // Read and validate content
            $content = file_get_contents($tmpFile);
            if ($content === false) {
                return ['error' => 'Failed to read upload'];
            }

            // Content security check
            if ($this->containsMaliciousContent($content)) {
                return ['error' => 'File rejected by security scan'];
            }

            // Write to staging
            $written = file_put_contents($stagingPath, $content);
            if ($written === false) {
                return ['error' => 'Write failed'];
            }

            // Phase 2: Atomic move from staging to final location
            // Verify staging file still belongs to us before moving
            $this->verifyAndCommit($stagingPath, $targetPath);

            return [
                'success' => true,
                'path' => $targetName,
                'size' => $written,
                'tenant' => $this->tenantId
            ];
        } finally {
            $this->releaseLock($lockResource);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Verify staging file integrity and commit to final path
     * The verification and commit must be atomic to prevent TOCTOU
     */
    private function verifyAndCommit(string $stagingPath, string $targetPath): void {
        // Verify the staging file exists and get its properties
        $stat = stat($stagingPath);
        if ($stat === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Staging file disappeared');
        }

        // Ensure it's a regular file owned by our process
        if (($stat['mode'] & 0170000) !== 0100000) {
            unlink($stagingPath);
            throw new \RuntimeException('Staging file is not a regular file');
        }

        // Validate path hasn't been tampered with (symlink check)
        if (is_link($stagingPath)) {
            unlink($stagingPath);
            throw new \RuntimeException('Symlink detected in staging');
        }

        // Commit: rename is atomic on same filesystem
        rename($stagingPath, $targetPath);
    }

    /**
     * Read a file belonging to this tenant
     */
    public function readFile(string $filename): ?string {
        $filename = basename($filename);
        $path = $this->baseDir . '/' . $filename;
        
        if (!$this->validateTenantPath($path)) {
            return null;
        }

        $lockResource = $this->acquireLock($this->tenantId . ':read:' . $filename);
        if ($lockResource === null) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            if (!file_exists($path)) {
                return null;
            }
            return file_get_contents($path);
        } finally {
            $this->releaseLock($lockResource);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Delete a file belonging to this tenant
     */
    public function deleteFile(string $filename): bool {
        $filename = basename($filename);
        $path = $this->baseDir . '/' . $filename;

        if (!$this->validateTenantPath($path)) {
            return false;
        }

        $lockResource = $this->acquireLock($this->tenantId . ':' . $filename);
        if ($lockResource === null) {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            if (is_link($path)) {
                return false;
            }
            if (file_exists($path)) {
                return unlink($path);
            }
            return false;
        } finally {
            $this->releaseLock($lockResource);
        }
    }

    private function containsMaliciousContent(string $content): bool {
        $signatures = ['<?php', '<?=', '<script', '#!/'];
        $lower = strtolower($content);
        foreach ($signatures as $sig) {
            if (strpos($lower, $sig) !== false) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

// Request handler
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    session_start();
    $tenantId = $_SESSION['tenant_id'] ?? null;
    if ($tenantId === null) {
        http_response_code(401);
        exit('Unauthorized');
    }

    $processor = new TenantFileProcessor($tenantId);

    $action = $_GET['action'] ?? '';
    header('Content-Type: application/json');

    switch ($action) {
        case 'upload':
            if (!isset($_FILES['file'])) {
                echo json_encode(['error' => 'No file provided']);
                break;
            }
            $result = $processor->processUpload(
                $_FILES['file']['tmp_name'],
                $_FILES['file']['name']
            );
            echo json_encode($result);
            break;

        case 'read':
            $name = $_GET['name'] ?? '';
            $content = $processor->readFile($name);
            if ($content === null) {
                echo json_encode(['error' => 'File not found']);
            } else {
                echo json_encode(['content' => base64_encode($content)]);
            }
            break;

        case 'delete':
            $name = $_GET['name'] ?? '';
            $result = $processor->deleteFile($name);
            echo json_encode(['success' => $result]);
            break;

        default:
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Unknown action']);
    }
}
